heading: Begin your personalized homeopathic treatment from home
subheading: Three steps take you from first consultation to remedies on your doorstep — guided by a doctor at every stage.

steps.title: Choose Your Plan
steps.body: Select a treatment plan, share your details and health concerns, then complete your secure online payment.

steps.title: Share Case Details
steps.body: Our doctors review your case, gather additional information if required, and prepare your personalized prescription.

steps.title: Receive Medicines
steps.body: Medicines are delivered to your doorstep with clear dosage instructions and regular follow-up support.

cta.title: Start Online Treatment
cta.body: Choose the treatment plan that best suits your needs and begin your journey to better health.
